name: Keto Sausage, Broccoli and Cheddar Egg Casserole
ingredients_verbatim: 3 cups broccoli (optional; cut into florets if using)
why: Egg/cheese-bound 9x13 casserole (12 eggs + heavy cream + 2 cups cheddar set the dish; sausage and broccoli are components) - textbook lane fit. Published macros land dead-center of the band: 463 cal, 25.7g protein, 4.2g total carbs. Scales cleanly to 14 servings as a bake with weigh-and-divide. Every main ingredient has a board home (breakfast-sausage, broccoli, eggs, heavy-cream, shredded cheddar, garlic, onions-free). No seafood. Verified from source nutrition card.
